test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept below F. Only two boxes are kept between F and A. Only D is kept immediately above B. C is kept at some place below G and at some place above E. How many boxes are kept between B and F?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. 

1) Only three boxes are kept below F.

2) Only two boxes are kept between F and A. 

3) Only D is kept immediately above B. 

4) C is kept at some place below G and at some place above E.
